userStatement: 按建议 / Ship as-is, fix later; 你直接做机器检查，修改好后，开始做l3 (delegation, 2026-10-11)

problems: back_translation addition: my brother -> my younger brother
groups.reason: 'my brother' is the younger brother throughout this story; Korean requires 남동생 (new flag on the rescreen under implementation 49f4e9bf)

problems: back_translation number: he brings -> they bring
back_translation meaning_shift: From upstairs, I hear two loud cracks. -> I hear a loud sound of something breaking upstairs twice.
groups.reason: 'two loud cracks' rendered as a loud breaking sound heard twice; same event (new flag on the rescreen under implementation 49f4e9bf)

problems: back_translation number: the trumpets are God's divine warnings -> the trumpet is God's warning
groups.reason: Korean does not mark the plural; 나팔 covers 'the trumpets'.

problems: back_translation meaning_shift: It is intense. -> It is truly amazing.
groups.reason: 'It is intense' rendered 엄청납니다 (tremendous); accepted for release, listed for post-release wording fix (new flag on the rescreen under implementation 49f4e9bf)

problems: back_translation addition: bloody vengeance, and divine wrath -> It is praising bloody revenge and God's wrath
groups.reason: Fragment that completes the preceding unit's 'praising ...'; the predicate is carried over, no new claim.

problems: back_translation meaning_shift: God is also wrathful -> God sometimes becomes angry
groups.reason: 'God is also wrathful' rendered 진노하기도 하는 (also shows wrath); meaning preserved (new flag on the rescreen under implementation 49f4e9bf)

problems: back_translation meaning_shift: He called me names. -> That kid swore at me.
back_translation addition: that little boy if we could borrow his PlayStation. -> Could you ask that little boy if we can borrow his PlayStation?
groups.reason: Fragment that completes 'I wanted to say to her, can you ask...'; the question form is the preceding unit's.

problems: Hangul share 0.59 < 0.60
back_translation number: but also signs -> but also through a sign
groups.reason: Korean does not mark the plural; 표징 covers 'signs'.

problems: back_translation number: Trumpets. -> It is a trumpet.
back_translation meaning_shift: He'd send a plague. -> God used to send disasters.
back_translation addition: how do you and I, -> how should you and I live?
groups.reason: Fragment 'how do you and I,' completed by the next unit ('In two ways'); 살아야 supplies the elided verb.

problems: back_translation addition: In two ways. -> We must live in two ways.
groups.reason: 'In two ways.' answers 'how do you and I [live]'; the verb is the same elided predicate.

problems: back_translation meaning_shift: My dad's heart was aching for my brother. -> My father was heartbroken because of my younger sibling.
back_translation addition: my brother -> my younger sibling
back_translation meaning_shift: but I missed it. -> but I did not understand his feelings.
back_translation addition: drop the hammer on you -> punishes you without mercy
back_translation meaning_shift: he was not self-righteous -> he did not boast about his own righteousness

back_translation meaning_shift: You walked in here tonight ... you quickly checked your old spiritual report card. -> Some of you came in here tonight ... you quickly checked your old spiritual report card.
groups.reason: The sermon is addressing a subset of listeners here (preceding 'Others of us...'); 여러분 중 어떤 분은 keeps that address.
